title: Gamma Vectors of Flag Homology Spheres
statement: What are the possible face numbers of flag simplicial spheres? In particular, if $\Delta$ is a flag homology sphere, is its $\gamma$-vector nonnegative, and is it the $f$-vector of a balanced simplicial complex?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Topological and Geometric Combinatorics (2011), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2011/08, pp. 349--423](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2011/08)

title: Colored Realizations of Gorenstein* $cd$-Indices
statement: Can the entire $cd$-index of every Gorenstein* poset be realized as the flag $f$-vector of a colored simplicial complex? More precisely, for a vertex coloring of a simplicial complex $\Delta$ with $\dim(\Delta)+1$ colors, where $f_S(\Delta)$ counts faces whose set of vertex colors is $S$, can the coefficients of the $cd$-index always be represented by such numbers $f_S(\Delta)$?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Topological and Geometric Combinatorics (2011), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2011/08, pp. 349--423](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2011/08)

title: Equality Cases in Lower Bounds for Triangulated 3-Manifolds
statement: For a closed $3$-manifold $M$, with $\Gamma(M)=\min_{|\Delta|=M}(f_{1}(\Delta)-4f_{0}(\Delta)+10)$, which manifolds besides connected sums of $S^{2}\times S^{1}$ and the nonorientable $S^{2}$-bundle over $S^{1}$ attain equality in the bound $\Gamma(M)\geq10\beta_{1}(M)$?
